question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH q4_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    c.cust_city,
    t.calendar_year,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND s.promo_id = 999
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT q4_2019.cust_city
  FROM q4_sales q4_2019
  JOIN q4_sales q4_2020 ON q4_2019.cust_city = q4_2020.cust_city
  WHERE q4_2019.calendar_year = 2019 AND q4_2020.calendar_year = 2020
    AND 1.0 * (q4_2020.total_sales - q4_2019.total_sales) / q4_2019.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.prod_id,
    t.calendar_year,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    prod_id,
    SUM(product_sales) as overall_sales
  FROM city_product_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT 
    prod_id,
    overall_sales,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY overall_sales DESC) as tile
  FROM product_overall
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id FROM ranked_products WHERE tile = 1
),
total_by_quarter AS (
  SELECT 
    t.calendar_year,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
product_share AS (
  SELECT 
    cps.prod_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cps.calendar_year = 2019 THEN cps.product_sales END) as product_sales_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cps.calendar_year = 2020 THEN cps.product_sales END) as product_sales_2020,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cps.calendar_year = 2019 THEN 1.0 * cps.product_sales / tby.total_sales END) as share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cps.calendar_year = 2020 THEN 1.0 * cps.product_sales / tby.total_sales END) as share_2020
  FROM city_product_sales cps
  JOIN total_by_quarter tby ON cps.calendar_year = tby.calendar_year
  WHERE cps.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
  GROUP BY cps.prod_id
)
SELECT 
  ps.prod_id,
  p.prod_name,
  ps.share_2019,
  ps.share_2020,
  ps.share_2020 - ps.share_2019 as share_change
FROM product_share ps
JOIN products p ON ps.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY share_change DESC
